name: bluetuith
summary: Terminal Bluetooth manager: pair, connect, transfer files and control media from a keyboard-driven UI
description: bluetuith is a TUI replacement for Bluetooth managers like blueman. It shows adapters and devices, handles pairing and authentication prompts, connects audio devices, sends and receives files over OBEX with a progress view, and includes a media player control. Mouse support is included. The project describes itself as alpha but is widely packaged.
